issue.title: Point sync at /self lists and clear cached milestones when membership is empty
issue.body:
## Summary / context

After the user leaves their last project, sync calls `GET /users/{userId}/projects` and gets **403 Insufficient permissions**. `retrySyncStep` throws, so milestones and chapter-assignments never run and local membership stays. The Milestones tab joins `user_projects`, so the cached row remains.

Blocked on [fluent-api#386](https://github.com/eten-tech-foundation/fluent-api/issues/386). Do not implement until those `/self` routes are on `main`.

## Current behavior

1. Sync calls `GET /users/{userId}/projects`, `/milestones`, `/chapter-assignments/all`, and `/chapter-assignments`.
2. Org Member with no project grant has neither `project:view` nor `user:view`, so the first call returns 403 and the rest never run.
3. `reconcileUserProjects` does not run, so `user_projects` keeps the old row.
4. `getMilestonesWithSummary` joins `user_projects`, and the Milestones tab still shows the cached milestone.
5. If membership were cleared first, `ensureUserProjectMembership` (called from `getMilestonesWithSummary`) would rebuild `user_projects` from leftover `chapter_assignments`. `reconcileUserMilestones` joins `user_projects`, so those units have to be deleted first.

## Expected behavior

Sync treats "I am in no project" as an empty list from the session routes:

- `getUserProjects` → `GET /self/projects`
- `getUserMilestones` → `GET /self/milestones`
- `getChapterAssignments` → `GET /self/chapter-assignments/all` (same query string)
- `getUserChapterAssignments` → `GET /self/chapter-assignments`

Keep the current method signatures so the `token` argument does not shift. The `userId` does not go in the URL.

When the projects response is a confirmed empty array, `syncProjects` calls `reconcileUserMilestones(userId, [])` and then `reconcileUserProjects(userId, [])`, and skips `ensureUserProjectMembership`. The Milestones tab stays empty on the next open.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] The four sync GETs hit `/self/...` and the request URL does not contain `/users/{userId}`.
- [ ] A confirmed empty projects response calls `reconcileUserMilestones(userId, [])` and then `reconcileUserProjects(userId, [])`.
- [ ] That empty path does not call `ensureUserProjectMembership`.
- [ ] A non-empty projects response still reconciles project ids only inside `syncProjects`, and does not call `reconcileUserMilestones` there.
- [ ] `npm test` for `api.milestones`, `sync.auth`, `sync.milestones`, and `sync.steps` passes.

## File pointers

| File | Notes |
|------|-------|
| `src/services/api.ts` | Four GET paths move to `/self/...` |
| `src/services/sync.ts` | Empty projects list reconciles milestones before membership |
| `src/db/repository.ts` | `reconcileUserMilestones` joins `user_projects`; `ensureUserProjectMembership` backfills from chapter assignments |
| `src/db/queries.ts` | `getMilestonesWithSummary` joins `user_projects` and calls `ensureUserProjectMembership` |

## Related

- [fluent-api#386](https://github.com/eten-tech-foundation/fluent-api/issues/386)
- [fluent-api#360](https://github.com/eten-tech-foundation/fluent-api/pull/360#issuecomment-6049724158)

## Out of scope

- Changing `GET /users/{userId}/...` on the API (that is #386)
- Treating an empty chapter-work list as an assignee wipe in `reconcileUserChapterWork`
- fluent-web
